description: Windah Basudara meets the Red Hulk in GTA VI: 'Gila, Red Hulk, nyata!', then 'dia Hulk Jump' over the bench press. Source = .cache/wizzclip/windah-gtavi-hulk/source.mp4 (also Drive clip-src/windah-gtavi-hulk.mp4): five pieces (0.6 s padding each) of the stream #7 hour-2 recording (windah-live7/stream-2259-0001.mp4, WIB = local + 22:59) in output order, 1080p30 re-encoded and joined. Cuts: T t 3133.50-3135.00 = local 0.60-2.10 -> output 0.00-1.50; B1 t 3183.60-3190.50 = local 3.30-10.20 -> output 1.50-8.40; B1b t 3197.60-3199.90 = local 11.40-13.70 -> output 8.40-10.70; B2 t 3373.90-3383.40 = local 14.90-24.40 -> output 10.70-20.20; B3 t 3387.20-3389.70 = local 25.60-28.10 -> output 20.20-22.70. Windah meets the giant red character (the Kyle side quest). Frame-0 teaser = the red giant standing at the barn door after the fight (52:13.5, 1.5 s, nobody hit in the shot), then stream order: 53:03.6 'Gila, Red Hulk, nyata, Joy!' and 'kali ini gue ngalah sama polisi, gue pulang' while driving away from the cops (3 stars, no gunfire on screen), 53:17.6 'kali ini gue ngalah segala-galanya ya', then 56:14 at the motel bench press, 'ada cutscene guys pas Red Hulk? eh dia lompat kocak, dia terbang ke atas ... terus dia Hulk Jump' (56:27). Word timings from faster-whisper medium with VAD on short windows. CUT: the whole fight 50:00-52:10 (throws, burning car, blood, bear hug at 52:00-52:08), the 52:37 swear ('anjir, beneran red'), 52:27-52:48 'polisi, babi', 53:24 whisper 'Red Bull' (misheard Hulk, brand), 53:11-53:17 repeated 'gue pulang' over a menu, 56:30 onward ('nonton youtube doang', platform name, then the third-party video). 'Hulk' is a character nickname only. Teaser check: the giant's skin is red with some scars/stains and torn jeans; it stands still and nobody is hit in 52:13.5-52:15 (a bear hug on Jason happens at 52:10-52:12, just before). Main 22.70 s + 4.0 s outro. Short format (user, 19 Nov: clips 45-60 s lost viewers at ~10 s, so aim for 20-30 s, payoff first). Facecam-below layout (windah_recipe.py layout 'face'): gameplay = source crop 1504x846 at (0,0) scaled to 1080x608 at y364 (the corner facecam is outside the crop, no blur), Windah's facecam = source crop 440x330 at (1480,516) scaled to 520x390 in a 4 px Volt frame, centred at x276, y994-1392, clear of TikTok's bottom caption area and right icon column; hook line 1 Paper 'RED HULK', line 2 Volt 'BENERAN ADA DI GTA VI', Audex 68, bottom-anchored at y318; credit tag y326; subs at y905 over the lower gameplay panel. Word timings from faster-whisper medium on boosted audio. Cuts on input 0 stay in source order; an earlier-shown later moment has its own seeked input.
